purpose: Case development, Chinese academic expression, and targeted evidence rechecking
reading_scope: Selected original sections where accessible; indexed excerpts are explicitly distinguished from opened full text. No claim of reading every paper in full.

sources.title: 中国人群健康相关生命质量概念框架构建：基于一般人群与疾病患者的质性研究
sources.access: Publisher-indexed expanded sections: abstract, coding method, six themes and discussion 4.1; direct opening returned 502.
sources.use: Describe constructs through everyday activities and experiences; distinguish symptoms, bodily function, cognition and social life. No participant quotations or new empirical estimates copied.

sources.title: 国内外普适性健康效用量表综述研究
sources.access: Publisher-indexed expanded abstract, measurement dimensions, discussion sections 3.1–3.3 and limitations; direct opening timed out.
sources.use: Separate health-state description, preference evaluation and instrument applicability. Historical statements about the absence of Chinese instruments were not repeated as current facts.

sources.title: 休闲方式你选对了吗？——基于主观幸福感的研究
sources.access: Original journal HTML opened; introduction, utility/time model, measurement discussion, results interpretation and conclusion read.
sources.use: Connect familiar leisure choices with time constraints. Did not adopt moralizing activity labels or convert observational associations into individual causal rankings. Style reference only.

sources.title: 基于大语言模型的自助式AI心理咨询系统构建及其效果评估
sources.access: Indexed original PDF excerpts and published author-response excerpts about discussion structure and limitations; direct PDF opening timed out.
sources.use: Name specific psychological outcomes and follow-up periods rather than a general claim of psychological improvement. No new effect sizes used.

sources.title: 青少年手机压力与心理健康的关系：基于多元宇宙样分析和密集追踪方法
sources.access: Publisher-indexed original abstract, introduction, conclusion and measurement appendix; direct PDF unavailable.
sources.use: Specify measured experiences and time frames; do not treat device duration as a general cognitive or health diagnosis. No study result generalized to adult AI use.

sources.title: Ultra-processed diets cause excess calorie intake and weight gain
sources.access: Original full-text record reopened: Summary, Food Intake, Glucose Tolerance/Figure 4, Limitations, Methods.
sources.use: Retain the original energy-intake estimate; add the short-term nonsignificant glucose findings to bound the claim. Distinguish controlled free meal provision from household decisions involving cost and convenience.

sources.title: Reliability of LLMs as medical assistants for the general public
sources.access: Original updated publisher record: abstract, main rationale, study design, performance results and user interactions.
sources.use: Confirm 1,298 participants and control-versus-pooled-AI recognition odds ratio 1.76 (95% CI 1.45–2.13); distinguish scenario performance from clinical outcomes.

sources.title: Generative AI at work
sources.access: Original publisher HTML: abstract, introduction, section VII.C and VIII conclusion.
sources.use: Confirm the 5,172-agent setting and average productivity result. Add that compensation data were unavailable; do not infer income or health gains directly from productivity.
